name: Prepared noise tensor as NOISE (replay)
plain: Wraps one already-made noise tensor as a NOISE object, so a sampler can be fed that exact tensor. The packs use this to guarantee that two passes share identical noise. These nodes only store and hand back a tensor; the distribution is whatever made it.
math: generate_noise(latent) returns stored ε; raises on shape mismatch.

providers.author: xmarre
providers.note: Keeps a CPU copy, returns a clone. Planner use in nodes.py not read.

providers.author: teenu
providers.note: Generates on the torch device and reports a SHA-256 of the tensor in its output
